glosses: pace (rough distance of a brisk stride)
paso, Spanish pace (a traditional unit of length equivalent to about 1.4 m)

examples.text: Tom quería seguir los pasos de su padre.
examples.en: Tom wanted to follow in his father's footsteps.

examples.text: Dé algunos pasos y dígame si duele cuando camina.
examples.en: Take a few steps and tell me if it hurts when you walk.
